topic.title: Legal and Disclaimers Resource File (conref targets)

draft-comment.b: Instructions for IPIX Users (tech writers and other authors):

ul.li: Use the Legal and Disclaimers Template (GUID-7AA2BDDE-E7F6-4A11-879A-3A9DEEDB9CCC) to create the legal and disclaimers topic for your publication.

Follow these steps:
Check out the Legal and Disclaimers Template
"Check in as..." to your publication's Topics folder
Customize to meet your needs.
When updating this file, DO NOT DELETE any of the paragraphs.

All the paragraphs are conref targets. They are referenced by the Legal and Disclaimers Template (GUID-7AA2BDDE-E7F6-4A11-879A-3A9DEEDB9CCC), as well as by any copies of this template that users have created for use in their publications.
The purpose in updating this file is to ensure the verbiage remains consistent with the verbiage on the Intel Legal website:
